$comment: Structure for a future Dispatches section. Nothing on the site reads this file yet, and no page or navigation link exists for it. It is here so the shape is decided before the content arrives. See content/README.md.

section.name: Dispatches
section.publishWhen: At least three real entries exist. Not before, and never with placeholder entries.

fields.title: required
fields.location: city or venue, only if Audrey was actually there
fields.why: one sentence on why she was there
fields.image: assets/dispatches/<id>.jpg, her own photograph or chosen video still
fields.meal: optional, only when a real meal is part of the entry
fields.fencing: optional, only when the trip was genuinely a competition

tableNotesExtraFields.rating: her own scale, defined once and kept consistent
tableNotesExtraFields.disclosure: none | gifted | invited | paid. Must be stated plainly on the entry whenever it is not none.
